title: [Preview] bc2adls and Fabric Open Mirroring
summary: bc2adls release 26.32 adds preview support for Microsoft Fabric Open Mirroring. Business Central data files go to a Fabric Landing Zone, and Fabric does the CDC processing itself, so no notebook is needed. Setup requires a Landing Zone string, a _metadata.json file created through Schema Export, and a __rowMarker__ column in the exported files.
key_points: Open Mirroring now accepts CSV as well as Parquet, which lets bc2adls feed Fabric without a notebook
Configure the Landing Zone string in bc2adls; authentication is the same as the regular Fabric integration
Schema Export creates the _metadata.json file, which defines the key columns and column data types
__rowMarker__ values: 0 means insert, 1 update, 2 delete; bc2adls does not use 4 (upsert)
File names must be 20-digit continuous numbers, and resetting a table restarts the numbering; the feature is in preview in both bc2adls and Fabric

quotes.text: So no need for running a notebook anymore. Fabric will do the CDC processing for you.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the key benefit of Open Mirroring - automatic data processing without manual intervention

quotes.text: The benefit is then that you can use the data faster!
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies the performance advantage of using Open Mirroring over manual notebook processing

quotes.text: Please mention that this feature is still in preview in bc2adls but also in Microsoft Fabric!
quotes.why_it_matters: Important caveat about the maturity level of both the feature and the tool
